notes.title: Hot Fixes!
notes.content:
Hey, good news from The Wardrobe!

The following issues are now fixed:
[list]
[*] Russian language issue
[*] "Concrete Block" achievement unlock issue
[*] Improved mouse scroll input
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and support :)

Cheers!

notes.title: The Wardrobe - Even Better Edition
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684379/10d641995f02676219c049b798a64377502a0c89.png[/img]

Hello world!

I'm Giulia, Producer of Gamera Interactive and I am happy to announce that we are going to publish a new, improved version of The Wardrobe!
Also, we are glad to inform you that the owners of the previous version will automatically receive all the new updates of The Wardrobe - Even Better Edition totally for free! Moreover a super amazing bundle including TW digital OST + the awesome Book of References will be available on Steam in a while (and even in a stand alone package of course, for who already owns the game).
 
Here you can find a brief list of all the new/improved features you will find in The Wardrobe - Even Better Edition:

[list]
[*] new hints and dialogue lines
[*] two new achievements (someone already knew about this ;P) 
[*] additional sound effects
[*] full joypad support
[*] 12 new easter eggs
[*] less than half the space now occupied on disk (~3GB vs 6.4GB) 
[*] RAM usage during execution has been drastically decreased! (it was the real bottleneck for the game)
[*] new post-processing effects in a specific location
[*] lower loading times at startup
[*] improved locations' loading system
[*] dubbing sound quality improved with additional cleaning work on the tracks, removal of some background noise and complete adjustment of silences to give the right rhythm during the dialogues
[*] language-independent saves, that will allow the player to switch language from main menu and continue a saved run to the new language (previously, once a run had started in a specific language, it was not possible to change it)
[*] chance to go back to the main menu
[*] jitter effect on texts
[*] logical bugs reported by the community & misc video issues fixed
[*] general improvements
[/list]

Mac users are going to receive an Even Better Wardrobe next week!

Hope you will enjoy

If you want to get in touch with the development team, join us on our discord channel https://discord.gg/FrHfyaG 

Cheers :)
